title: Normalized degree comparisons for affine singleton tensor sections
statement: Let X be a scheme, F a quasi-coherent X-module, U,W affine etale X-schemes, and g:W→U. Set A=Γ(U,O), B=Γ(W,O), and M=Γ(U,U*F). Let C be the lifted tensor-section singleton Cech complex and T the lifted, scalar-forgotten Amitsur complex A,B,M. There are isomorphisms e(n):T.X(n)→C.X(n) for all n. Let P(n) be the categorical product of n+1 copies of W→U in Over U, q(k):P(n)→W its projections, and π(n) evaluation of the singleton outer section product at the unique tuple. For all m in M and functions b:Fin(n+1)→B, π(n)(e(n)(ULift(m tensor tprod(b)))).down equals (product over k of q(k)^sharp(b(k))) times the tensor-section restriction of m along P(n)→U. This is IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison in Lean. No differential compatibility is asserted. [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] [lem-pc-cech-exact] [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]

lean.statement:
theorem exists_singletonTensorDegreeComparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left) :
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ≅
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n,
      ∀ n, IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison X F U W g n (e n)
